note: Canonical eval fixture: the build agent's paraphrase of Schellenberg's standard (2015) formulation of the hiddenness argument. Used only by E2 (gauntlet calibration); not a corpus record and never cited.
title: The hiddenness argument (Schellenberg, standard form)

premises.EVAL.p1: If a perfectly loving God exists, then there exists a God who is always open to a personal relationship with any finite person.
premises.EVAL.p2: If there exists a God who is always open to a personal relationship with any finite person, then no finite person is ever nonresistantly in a state of nonbelief in relation to the proposition that God exists.
premises.EVAL.p3: If no perfectly loving God exists, then God does not exist.
premises.EVAL.p4: Some finite persons are or have been nonresistantly in a state of nonbelief in relation to the proposition that God exists.
